dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Localized high-intensity pixel clusters are concentrated in the posterior region near the flipper base, with smaller, scattered high-intensity cores nested within the central lateral ring structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest mid-lateral macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle, while the relationship between the posterior high-intensity cluster and the primary dorsal annuli defines a linear geometric axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible interlocking reticulated network where the edges of adjacent macro-annuli merge into a continuous web-like pattern across the mid-section of the frame.
